title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical port
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical portrait of a young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing indoors beside an ornate decorative wall in a bright upscale corridor. Her ethnicity is unspecified because race or ethnicity cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has smooth fair-to-light skin with a soft luminous complexion, a delicate oval face, a gently tapered jawline, subtle cheekbones, a petite straight nose, naturally soft red-pink lips, and neatly shaped dark eyebrows. Her dark brown almond-shaped eyes look directly into the camera with a warm, relaxed, subtly playful expression. Her lips form a small closed-mouth smile, and her head is angled slightly toward one shoulder.

Her hair is a sleek short dark-brown bob cut ending around the jaw and upper neck, with softly layered ends curving inward. It is parted slightly off-center, with long face-framing sections sweeping diagonally across her forehead and falling beside both cheeks. A few fine strands rest naturally near her temples and ears.

She stands close to the wall with her upper body angled three-quarters toward the camera, one shoulder positioned slightly forward. The framing extends from above her head to around the upper hips. One arm hangs naturally beside her body while the other appears extended toward or near the camera, creating the intimate perspective of a handheld portrait. Her posture is upright yet casual, with a gentle curve through the torso.

She wears a fitted white ribbed halter-style camisole with very thin spaghetti straps, a low scoop neckline, deeply open sides, and narrow crisscrossing white tie straps wrapping around the side of her torso and lower back. The fabric hugs her body naturally. At the lower edge of the frame she wears loose light-gray casual drawstring bottoms, with the gathered waistband visible.

Behind her is a textured pale cream wall decorated with oversized layered geometric architectural lettering or sculptural reliefs in champagne-beige and rose-gold tones. A continuous pink LED accent strip runs horizontally along the lower wall, casting a soft rosy glow onto the wall, trim, and her skin. The polished light-colored floor subtly reflects the ambient lighting. Use soft diffused indoor illumination, flattering skin rendering, gentle highlight rolloff, minimal hard shadows, a slightly elevated close perspective, approximately a 28–35mm full-frame lens, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, clean high-end smartphone photography realism, soft pastel cream and blush color grading, realistic skin texture, natural proportions, crisp facial focus, and subtle cinematic contrast. Aspect ratio 9:16.
